webNotes: New in 2.4.13: Autumn joins the shared apartment — her own 3D avatar, built from her Tripo model and slimmed to her real build (5'6", 115 lbs, petite; face and hair untouched). She stands beside Aimmianna, walks with her when the floor is tapped, hugs and hearts with her on the warm poses, and waves hello when tapped. Same height as Aimmianna — 1.7 units, never bigger. She lives in the shared side only, never in Tony's private Game Mode, and nothing of her private collection or private memories goes anywhere shared. Everything from 2.4.12 still stands: the dedication to Emmi on the front of the app, the five mood poses, two doors two keys, guest codes, the Her World menu, and Rule 1.

sharedRelease.text: Apartment Life and shared companion memory affect both devices. Check for updates on your iPhone and Android.

notes: Fixes the Android app reloading over and over on a new install, and stops the live wallpaper from overwriting newer changes made in the app.
